description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling the ModifyFeatures command in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically modifying or creating features of a Thing entity.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the ModifyFeatures command, allowing modification or creation of features in a Thing entity.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command to modify or create features on a Thing, validating size and returning the appropriate result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Creates a modification event and response when features are updated.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Creates a creation event and response when features are added to a new Thing.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the previous entity tag based on the current features of the Thing.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag from the features in the command.
